title: What Is MCP (Model Context Protocol)? A Plain-English Guide for Developers
summary: MCP is the standard that lets AI agents connect to external tools — databases, GitHub, file systems, search. Here's how it works, why it matters, and how to use it with Claude Code and Cursor.
body_markdown: MCP Apps (formalized as SEP-1865 in early 2026) extends the base protocol to support interactive UIs — React dashboards, charts, forms — delivered from an MCP server directly into the host application. Before MCP Apps, servers could only return text and structured data. Now an Amplitude server can render an analytics chart inside Cursor. Cursor 2.6 (March 3, 2026) was the first major IDE to ship MCP Apps support.
